T1.statement: Between 5% and 30% of the files read have at least one step faster than the limit for its route_type.

T2.statement: Fewer than 5% of the files read have at least one step where a trip arrives before it left the stop before.

T3.statement: Fewer than 3% of the files read have a pole with missing, zero or outside-Japan coordinates.

T4.statement: The median scheduled straight-line speed of bus trips, over all bus trips in all files read, is between 12 and 25 km/h.

T5.statement: At least half of all too-fast steps are scheduled at under one minute (0 minutes in a timetable given to the minute).

T6.statement: At least 10% of the files read have a stack: two or more differently named poles at exactly the same coordinates.
